# Deutsch

Translate into German. Each choice below is a default, made without a native speaker's review, and a native speaker may change any of it.

## Register

- Warm and plain, as a small shop speaks to its customers; address the reader with "du".
- Headings and buttons follow German capitalization.

## Quotation marks

- A quoted phrase takes „so“, and a quotation inside it takes ‚so‘.

## Terms kept as they are

- The glossary's do-not-translate terms, in the casing of each occurrence.

A native speaker who finds a default here wrong corrects this file; every translation made after the correction follows it.
